mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.session_id, m.sender_id, CASE m.sender_type WHEN 1 THEN u.nickname WHEN 2 THEN cs.nickname ELSE '未知' END as senderName, m.sender_type, CASE m.sender_type WHEN 1 THEN '用户' WHEN 2 THEN '客服' ELSE '未知' END as senderTypeName, m.message_type, CASE m.message_type WHEN 1 THEN '文本' WHEN 2 THEN '图片' WHEN 3 THEN '文件' ELSE '未知' END as messageTypeName, m.content, m.is_read, m.create_time FROM customer_service_message m LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON m.sender_id = u.id AND m.sender_type = 1 LEFT JOIN sys_user cs ON m.sender_id = cs.id AND m.sender_type = 2 WHERE m.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY m.create_time ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_service_message m INNER JOIN customer_service_session s ON m.session_id = s.session_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND m.sender_type = 2 AND m.is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_service_message m INNER JOIN customer_service_session s ON m.session_id = s.session_id SET m.is_read = 1 WHERE s.session_id = #{sessionId} AND s.user_id = #{userId} AND m.sender_type = 2 AND m.is_read = 0
